jessica (support): FYI — Customer Anya reported an invoice that was charged but the PO number is missing on the PDF and portal. They need a reissued invoice with PO included or a credit+rebill. Ticket INC-9284.
anya (customer): Hi — we paid already but accounting needs PO# on invoice for internal reconciliation. Can you add it and reissue? Prefer no refund if possible.
jessica (support): Understood. Can finance confirm we can do a post-pay backfill (credit note + reissue) or just regenerate the invoice with a note? Rafael?
rafael (finance): For legal/tax we usually issue a credit note then reissue a corrected invoice if the original payment already settled. Need GL codes and confirmation of no VAT change. Also need the original invoice id and payment ref.
jessica (support): Invoice id: INV-2026-1173, payment ref: PAY-9X7-332. Customer says PO: PO-557-ACME. The invoice PDF shows no purchase_order field.
liam (billing-engineer): @munir can you check ingestion/logs — looks like the portal encoded PO into metadata but our invoice generator didn't pick it up. I pulled the invoice JSON and the field is null:
```
{"invoice_id":"INV-2026-1173","customer_id":"ACMEINC","amount":1420.00,"purchase_order":null}
```
liam (billing-engineer): Quick repro steps for platform: 1) check invoices table: `select id, purchase_order from invoices where id='INV-2026-1173';` 2) check webhook payload sent from portal: `curl -X POST https://ingest.redwood/api/v1/invoice -d @payload.json` 3) sample payload we received attached in ticket.
munir (platform): Confirmed — ingest logs show PO present in incoming webhook but a downstream mapper dropped it because of a schema mismatch (portal sent `poNumber` not `purchase_order`). Patch queued to map both keys. PR: #billing/1456.
jessica (support): Thanks. ETA on deploy? Customer is pushing for same-day reissue.
munir (platform): Hotfix deploy scheduled in 30 mins to staging, 90 mins to prod assuming no regressions. After deploy, we can regenerate the invoice PDF and push to the portal.
rafael (finance): If we can regenerate with PO intact and no tax change, we can issue a corrected invoice PDF (no credit) and stamp it as a corrected copy. If legal requires cancellation + reissue we will do credit+rebill — that takes ~24-48h for processing.
anya (customer): Regenerate is fine as long as it has PO and original payment reference. Prefer faster option.
jessica (support): Plan: 1) munir deploys patch -> 2) liam runs regen script for INV-2026-1173 -> 3) attach new PDF to ticket and notify customer -> 4) finance confirms if credit needed. I'll update INC-9284 with steps and timeline.
liam (billing-engineer): Regen command I'm planning:
```
python scripts/regenerate_invoice.py --id INV-2026-1173 --force-pdf
```
liam (billing-engineer): After regen I'll verify `purchase_order` is present in invoice JSON and the PDF renders it.
rafael (finance): Also include this note on the new invoice: "Corrected to include customer PO: PO-557-ACME" — preserves audit trail.
jessica (support): Noted. I'll tell Anya ETA ~2hrs for updated PDF, or next-day if finance needs credit. @anya we'll DM updates.
ingest-bot: deploy-started billing-mapping-hotfix by munir at 2054322010 :rocket:
munir (platform): Deploy to prod completed at 2054322035, mapping now accepts `poNumber` and `purchase_order`.
liam (billing-engineer): Regen done at 2054322042. Invoice JSON now:
```
{"invoice_id":"INV-2026-1173","customer_id":"ACMEINC","amount":1420.00,"purchase_order":"PO-557-ACME"}
```
liam (billing-engineer): New PDF uploaded to portal and attached to INC-9284.
jessica (support): Sent updated PDF to customer and cc'd finance. Rafael — can you confirm if this workflow requires credit note or if corrected copy is sufficient?
rafael (finance): Reviewed — corrected copy OK in this case (no VAT change). No credit needed. I'll close the finance side once I log the journal entry. Closing note: GL 4100, tax code VAT0.
anya (customer): Got it, PDF looks good, thanks everyone! :tada:
jessica (support): Closing INC-9284 after finance logs. Follow-up: liam to add regression unit test to ensure mapping handles both keys. Marking postmortem action.
liam (billing-engineer): Adding test ticket: BIL-789; will include in next sprint.
